description: Encounter a more intense battle, dice rolls are frequent, each character takes turns attacking, the battle situation is full of ups and downs

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: Ge Qing struck Rumia with a stick.

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: "Don't cry." #Crouches down to wipe away her tears.

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: Long'er, crouching down, saw that Rumia was still smiling.

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: The surrounding scenery dissolved instantly like spilled ink. The snow underfoot, the distant lights, even the falling snow in the sky vanished in an instant. You are plunged into absolute, silent darkness. The only light source comes from Rumia's figure floating in the air—she is crouched, tilting her head with a playful grin. Ten dark red ribbons extending from her fingertips writhe through the void like living things.

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "Feels like something bad is about to happen."

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: In the darkness, crimson pupils flash with an inexplicable light.

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: "Everyone can try to knock Rumia out."

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "Youkai... really are scary after all." #Sheds tears.

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: Darkness: Scene. Within the darkness, any attack with a success level less than 2 cannot hit Rumia.

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "Then... then I'm sorry, waaaaah!" #Summons the Devourer, then reaches her hand into its mouth to pull out that bloodstained, rusty saw cleaver.

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: "Rumia, I feel your will, but I'm sorry."

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: Only laughter responds to Long'er in the darkness.

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: #Long'er takes out his Messiah Fist and puts it on his left hand.

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "Hmm..." #Bites down on her own arm, then rapidly enlarges the unknown creature composed of mouths and eyes behind her, making it bite towards Rumia's location. Meanwhile, Xueyu drags the heavy saw cleaver and swings it in sync with the creature's bite. The bloodstains on the saw cleaver seem to boil at this moment.

conversation.speaker: player6
conversation.text: [Great Writer]'s 'Soul Hunt' check: Roll: 1D20+4+2d4=4+4+{1+4}(5)=13 Challenge: 10 Success Success level: 1

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "So... so powerful..." #quietly shrinks behind Voracious Eater

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: #Enters a state of rage; the previous calm instantly dissipates, replaced by a wrathful Vajra-like countenance.

conversation.speaker: player6
conversation.text: [Observer Ge Qing]'s 'Soul Hunt' check: Roll: 1D20+8d4+1d6=19+{3+4+2+1+3+3+2+2}(20)+{4}(4)=43 Challenge: 10 Success Success level: 7
